_what: Pre-registered power basis for the M9.1 screen decision rules (Codex MAJOR-2). Empirical distribution of per-query nDCG@10 DIFFERENCE standard deviations over 2,031 system pairs found in M7/M8's committed dev per-query dumps (results/m7_devperquery_*.json.gz), computed on the same two surfaces M9 decides on. Measured BEFORE any M9 arm was trained.
caveat: These pairs are mostly close variants of one table family, so they may understate the spread between two different STUDENT backbones. The p90 row is used as the planning value.
